answer: Make each agent identity post a refundable stake bond before it can transact. Like planting one tree in an orchard, every identity costs real capital up front, not free timber anyone can chop. Spin up 10,000 sybils and you must lock 10,000 bonds; any detected fraud slashes that stake, so one bad act sends a costly ripple across the attacker's whole fleet. Honest agents reclaim their bond, while the attacker's cost scales linearly per identity, killing the cheap-copy economics sybils rely on.
